name: The Transfer of the Relics of the Monk Theodore Sikeotes, Bishop of Anastasiupolis
life: The Transfer of the Relics of the Monk Theodore Sikeotes, Bishop of Anastasiupolis (+ 22 April 613), was from Galatia to Constantinople, done not earlier than the IX Century. His relics were seen in the year 1200 by the Russian pilgrim Antonii at the monastery of Saint George.
